summary: S048 — Backend fully validated for (1) GRH duplicate-prev-month bonuses (already covered by test_siter39s_primes_indemnites.py) and (2) S044 Liluvine chat-with-image. Ran the requested 3-suite regression `pytest test_siter39s_primes_indemnites.py test_siter39t_s044_vision_compare.py test_siter39r_p1_vision_enrich.py` → 15/15 PASS. Also wrote and ran a live HTTP E2E test against the public ingress URL (https://sawali-portal.preview.emergentagent.com) for POST /api/me/liluvine-pro/chat-with-image with admin OTP login + a valid 2x2 PNG → 200 with full response shape (ok=true, session_id, message_id, reply, image_analysis{ocr_text,visual_summary}, matched_images[], user_image_url), and GET /api/me/liluvine-pro/sessions/{sid} returns BOTH a user message (with user_image_url + image_analysis + matched_images) and an assistant message — exactly as specified. The non-image 400/403 path is also validated. Frontend code review confirms all required testids (hr-bonus-duplicate-prev with 'Dupliquer YYYY-MM' label; liluvine-attach-image-btn/input/preview/remove; liluvine-send-btn flips 'Envoyer'→'Analyser'; liluvine-msg-user-image; liluvine-msg-matched-images) are present and wired correctly. Frontend Playwright UI exercise was inconclusive: the automated login path failed (cookie-consent overlay + a non-standard OTP input layout that did not match our selectors — same root cause flagged in iter47 console errors) and localStorage token injection redirected to the public marketing landing page (AuthContext clears token if /api/auth/me race-condition hits). After 3 attempts, hit loop-prevention — recommending main_agent_can_self_test=true given backend is 100% and code review of UI is clean.

critical_code_review_comments: HrPrimesIndemnites.jsx (551 lines): previousMonth memo correctly handles YYYY-MM arithmetic (rolls year on Jan→Dec). duplicateFromPreviousMonth() uses window.confirm if items.length>0 (good UX, idempotent-friendly per spec) and correctly POSTs each prev bonus to the current month — but it does NOT check for duplicates server-side, so repeated clicks WILL create duplicates. That matches spec ('add by-dessus without écraser') but main agent may want a uniqueness key (employee+month+label) later.

LiluvinePro.jsx: sendWithImage() builds multipart FormData with file+text+session_id; reply is appended optimistically and then replaced with server reply — clean. The matched_images grid only renders when array is non-empty (good).

Backend liluvine_pro.py:779-949 chat_with_image endpoint is well-structured: feature gate → quota pre-check → content-type guard → 15MB size limit → storage (best-effort) → Claude Vision (best-effort, swallows errors) → Qdrant search (best-effort) → message persist → LLM call → assistant persist. Robust against partial failures as required.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend chat-with-image is fully working end-to-end against the public URL — proof: tests/test_iter48_chat_with_image_http.py both tests pass with admin login. For the frontend Playwright flow, the cleanest path is: (a) navigate to /login, (b) fill email+password, (c) click 'Se connecter', (d) wait for OTP form, (e) fetch a NEW dev_otp from a parallel POST /api/auth/login (the one from before login click is already consumed by the form), (f) the OTP UI may be 6 separate boxes — selector pattern that worked previously: 'input[autocomplete=one-time-code], input[inputmode=numeric]'. If that fails, you can also call /api/auth/verify-otp directly to get a token, then `localStorage.setItem('sawali_token', token)` + `localStorage.setItem('sawali_user', JSON.stringify(meFromApiAuthMe))` BEFORE any goto, then goto with wait_until='networkidle' — but be aware the AuthContext clears token if /api/auth/me 401s during the race.
